info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Internal Bank Account API
info.description: The Internal Bank Account API provides functionalities to access and manage internal bank account information within the banking systems. This API allows users to retrieve account details, transaction history, and account statuses. Typical consumers include internal banking systems and financial applications requiring real-time account data for operational processes. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their financial service deliveries and streamline internal banking operations.

get.summary: Retrieve information about internal bank accounts.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details of internal bank accounts managed by the operational services. It provides comprehensive data including account balances, transaction history, and account status, enabling informed decisions and efficient financial operations.
